statement: The rolling-restart liveness analyzer consumes linked full-log replay evidence for stat-gate-20260629T045155Z-run1 and reports a grounded publication-liveness verdict: either a non-insufficient taxonomy verdict with concrete execution/progress/visibility evidence, or insufficient_evidence only when a complete full-log scan proves the required evidence is absent; enqueue/backlog alone still cannot be progress.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not classify absence of owner execution from sparse playback; use linked full logs or keep the verdict insufficient with named gaps.
Do not classify enqueue, backlog, retry scheduling, or queue growth as observed progress without a later concrete progress witness.
Do not run a new rolling-restart statistical gate for this Quest; mechanism classification is deterministic replay work.

doneWhenSealed.closure: The analyzer extends the existing deterministic liveness classifier with linked full-log replay evidence. This Quest does not claim product stability, does not run a new statistical gate, and does not mutate the run4 Quest.
acceptance: Given test-output/reports/stat-gate-20260629T045155Z-run1.report.json, the analyzer resolves the linked .full-logs/rolling-restart log set and includes full-log replay metadata in the verdict.

The run1 verdict is either a non-insufficient taxonomy verdict with concrete execution/progress/visibility evidence from the full logs, or insufficient_evidence only when a complete full-log scan reports the missing evidence class.
Enqueue, backlog, retry scheduling, and queue growth are still not classified as observed progress without a later progress witness.
Deterministic fixtures cover full-log execution evidence, complete full-log no-execution evidence, and missing full-log fallback behavior.
